evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

observations.why: Position-holder sets a recurring cadence by directive — authority of role plus insistence on a deadline-driven schedule.

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Logical equivalence framed as a maxim — argument from reasoning plus insistence that the unrehearsed equals the nonexistent.

mints.name: MandateByMaxim
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is authority here being claimed through an aphoristic equivalence rather than through rank or process?
